Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. Afghanistan have managed to keep their hopes alive in this series. It currently stands at 2-1 in Ireland's favour. The two sides will meet again on 15th August, 2022. The first ball will be at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Till then, take care and goodbye.

Mohammad Nabi, the victorious skipper is in for a chat. He says that the batted according to the plan. The opening stand was the key to post a huge total on the board. Mentions they played a great game, just the Afghan way. Says the team performed really well and hopefully they can emulate the same in the next two games.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says they lost a lot of wickets in the Powerplay and that put them on the back foot. Praises the effort of the batters at the fag end and kept them in the game for long. Says Hume and Hand have been knocking on the door for quite some time and is really glad to have them in the side. Mentions, Dockrell has gone from strength-to-strength which is really pleasing to see. Mentions, they have played pretty good cricket and would aim to win the series.

Rahmanullah Gurbaz wins the Man of the Match award for his exceptional effort with the bat. He starts by saying it feels good to win after two losses on the trot. Says the coach and the skipper asked him to stay out for long and that's what he aimed to do. Says he is really happy to see Zazai back in the side. Ends by saying he hopes they can win the rest of the matches.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the innings, Afghanistan started well with the blade. Their openers built a solid foundation up top. Rahmanullah Gurbaz smacked a quickfire 53. Later, the middle order capitalized on this opportunity and punched 189 runs on the board. Ireland though could not get a good start with the blade and that costed them the game here.

Afghanistan bowlers finally came to the fore. They managed to pick wickets regularly and that completely pushed the hosts on the back foot. It was a complete performance from the visitors and they completely outplayed the hosts. Also, surprisingly, Rashid Khan has failed to pick a single wicket in this series until now, He will be hoping to change his fortunes in the remaining games.

The Ireland batters just did not arrive today! They needed the top order to fire but that did not happen and then the task just getting difficult. George Dockrell is the only batter who showed some fight in this chase. He recorded his highest ever score in T20Is with his 58 runs. He got good support from the debutant, Fionn Hand as well, but it was too little too late.

A thumping win for the visitors to stay alive in the series. To be honest this victory was set up by the batters. 190 was always going to be an uphill task against this Afghanistan bowling attack and the Afghans got their A-game to the fore to bag their first win of the tour.
Azmatullah Omarzai serves it full, wide outside off. George Dockrell looks to drive it away but misses. Afghanistan win the game by 22 runs.
WIDE! On a length, outside the tramline. George Dockrell misses his attempt. Wided.
Swing and a miss! Length ball, outside off. George Dockrell looks to heave it away but misses.
Length ball, on off, pushed to wide long off.
On off, this is pushed to sweeper cover,
FOUR! Finds the gap now! It is full, outside off. George Dockrell leans in and drives it through covers. It splits the two fielders in the deep and crosses the boundary.
Full length, on off. George Dockrell gets it to mid-wicket off the inner half. George Dockrell needs to hit 5 balls out of the park to win the game here.

OUT! RUN OUT! Graham Hume gives away his wicket here, as he wanted to keep George Dockrell on strike. It is a short ball, down leg. Graham Hume pulls it to fine leg and the call is for two. Mujeeb Ur Rahman throws it to the keeper. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is quick to clip the bails off. The square leg umpire raises his finger. Graham Hume has to walk back. Josh Little is the last man in for Ireland.
Commentary.Howout: run out (Mujeeb Ur Rahman / Rahmanullah Gurbaz)

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Short one, down leg. Hume lets it be. Wided.
A single now as this is pushed to extra cover.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fionn Hand's cameo comes to an end. He receives an applause as he head out of the field. It is full, on off. Fionn Hand shuffles across and ramps it over short fine leg. Hazratullah Zazai runs behind and takes a sharp catch over his shoulders. This is should ease down some pressure for Afghanistan. Graham Hume is the new batter in for Ireland.

SIX! This is gone all the way! It is full and outside off. Fionn Hand stays back and smokes it over the wide long off fence for a biggie. Fionn Hand is on a roll here. 7 runs off the first three balls here. Ireland need 31 off 9 balls.
A length ball, around off. Fionn Hand looks to go for the reverse sweep but misses.
Naveen-ul-Haq steams in and angles it in, full and on off. George Dockrell drives it to long off and rotates the strike.

Touch short, on middle and leg. Fionn Hand pulls it to deep square leg. Naveen-ul-Haq in the deep makes an exceptional stop with a dive. They take two. George Dockrell to be on strike for the penultimate over.
On off, pushed to covers for one.
FOUR! George Dockrell racks up his fifty! It is short, on off. George Dockrell swivels on the back foot and pulls it through square leg for four. Can Ireland pull a rabbit out of the hat here?
A single now as this is pushed to covers.
On middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Incredible shot! It is full and on off. George Dockrell drills it straight down the ground, It is in the gap and races away.
Rashid Khan is back into the attack for his final over.
SIX! All the way! Fionn Hand stands and delivers this time. It is a short ball, outside off. Hand clubs it over the covers fence for a maximum.
A length ball, outside off. Hand shuffles across and tries to scoop it over the keeper's head. He mishits to point.
Full length, on off. George Dockrell drives it to covers for a single.
A length ball, on the pads, George Dockrell works it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Top shot! Naveen-ul-Haq bends his back this time and serves a short ball, outside off. George Dockrell stands tall and slaps it down the ground for four.
A slower short ball, outside off. George Dockrell fails to pick it up and leaves it alone.
Change. Naveen-ul-Haq is back into the attack now.
On middle and leg, George Dockrell tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! Full, just outside off. George Dockrell looks to chase it but misses.
Quicker and full, outside off. George Dockrell works it to the off side off the inner half.
Fuller, on off. George Dockrell drives it to deep point for a single.
This is swept again. This time to deep square leg. Rashid Khan is sharp in the field. One taken.
FOUR! Nicely played! Fionn Hand looks to be in good form. It is flighted and full, around middle. Hand shuffles across and sweeps it down to fine leg for a boundary.

Tossed up, on off. George Dockrell pushes it to the right of the bowler. Rashid Khan manages to get hand to it before it went on to disturb the stumps at the non-striker's end. They appeal for run out but nothing given.
FOUR! Down the ground. It is floated and full, on off. George Dockrell slams it down to long off and gets a boundary.
FOUR! Afghanistan have not been great in the field. It is short, on off. George Dockrell pulls it to deep mid-wicket. One bounce and into the ropes.
It is tossed up, full and on off. It stays low off the deck. George Dockrell is unable to work it away.
Full length, on off. George Dockrell lofts it towards long off. The batters run two.
SIX! BANG! George Dockrell joins the party now. It is tossed up, full and on off. George Dockrell makes room and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! It is floated and full, around middle. Hand gets low and looks to sweep it away. It goes down to third man off the back of the blade. It is another boundary. He moves to 16 off 9.
FOUR! Nicely played! It is tossed up, around off. Hand drives it through covers for a boundary. Exceptional shot.
A low full toss, on off. George Dockrell hits it to deep square leg. One taken.
Hand pushes this full delivery to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Fionn Hand gets his first boundary in T20I cricket. It is full and on off. Hand gets low and sweeps it through square leg. It races away.
Tossed up, outside off. Hand gets behind and defends it back to the bowler.
Looped up, on off. Hand pushes it to cover and gets a single.
Around off, Hand looks to chase it but misses.

Overthrows now! It is around off. Hand taps it to backward point and scampers across for a quick single. The fielder scores a direct-hit at the non-striker's end. It defelects off the stumps. They sneak another single.
Pushed through quicker, on off. Hand looks to drive it away but misses.
Fionn Hand is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mujeeb Ur Rahman gets his second wicket. It is floated and full, on off. Mark Adair gets behind it and lofts it over the bowler's head towards long off. Rashid Khan settles under it and takes a sharp catch near the ropes.
Commentary.Howout: c Rashid Khan b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: A single now as this is worked to mid on.
George Dockrell nudges this full delivery through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, George Dockrell looks to chase it but misses.
On middle and leg, tucked to square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Risky running! George Dockrell could've gone back to the hut but the umpire disagrees. It is full, on the stumps. Mark Adair flicks it to deep mid-wicket. The batters decide to take two. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end from the deep but the umpire thinks the batters is safely inside the crease.
Is that a run out? The umpire shows no interest. Although, Mohammad Nabi looked delighted.
Darted on the pads, Mark Adair flicks it to deep square leg. The batters collect a brace.
Flatter and on off. George Dockrell pushes it to mid on for a single.
On off, blocked out.
On off, pushed to sweeper cover for a single.

SIX! All the way! It is short, on off. George Dockrell stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and puts in a dive to that side. The ball though goes over him and into the fence.
A googly now around off, Adair works it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. George Dockrell pushes it to deep point for one.
Fuller, on off. George Dockrell lofts it over mid off. They take two.
Full and on off. George Dockrell sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Drinks! This has been a dominating performance from Afghanistan so far. They did not let any Irish batter to settle-in and are in a comfortable position to get over the line here.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another man bites the dust. It is full and on off. Gareth Delany gets low and slogs it to deep mid-wicket. This has no power to reach the fence. Najibullah Zadran in the deep settles under it and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Najibullah Zadran b Mohammad Nabi

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker one, on off. George Dockrell slaps it to long off for a single.
It is flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Gareth Delany. It is short, outside off. Gareth Delany stays back and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
On off, blocked out.
Darted on the pads, Gareth Delany flicks it to square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
George Dockrell is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mujeeb Ur Rahman gets himself into the wicket's column. Half of the Ireland side is back in the dressing room. It is short, on off. Tucker stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Naveen-ul-Haq in the deep dives to his right and takes an incredible catch to see the back of the in-form batter in Lorcan Tucker.
Commentary.Howout: c Naveen-ul-Haq b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: MISFIELD AND FOUR! Fuller one, on off. Tucker gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Usman Ghani is unable to keep the ball in control. It clears the fence.
Quicker, flatter, on off. Tucker comes down the track and eases it out to the off side.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.

DROPPED! It is full, outside off. Gareth Delany gets low and throws his blade at it. It goes over covers off his splice. The fielder runs backward and is unable to keep his eyes on the ball. It lands safely. Two taken.
Short ball, on off. Gareth Delany stays back and slaps it to long off for two more.
Tossed up, on off. Gareth Delany drives it towards sweeper cover. They take two. 50 up for the hosts now.
Lorcan Tucker sweeps this full delivery towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Full and on off. Gareth Delany slogs it to wide long on for a single.
A low full toss, on off. Gareth Delany hits it hard to wide long on. They come back for two.
On the pads, Delany tucks it to the vacant area at mid-wicket and cross for one.
Full, on off. Tucker sweeps it to deep square leg. They take one.
This is worked through mid-wicket for a brace. Good running this time.
On off, defended out.

A huge appeal for lbw! In fact Rashid Khan is down on his knees but the finger stays down. It is floated and full, around off. Tucker looks to sweep it away but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Khan appeals but in vain.
FOUR! Edgy! It is quicker and full, outside off. Lorcan Tucker looks to drive it away. It takes a thick outside edge and races away down to the third man fence.
It is a length ball. Gareth Delany flicks it to short fine leg off his pads, but not in the gap. At the end of Powerplay, Ireland are 36/4.
Gareth Delany is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Curtis Campher reads the delivery really well but holes out instead. It is a slower ball, length and on off. Curtis Campher waits for it and slams it to the right of mid on. He could not get it off the middle. Najibullah Zadran moves to his right and takes an easy catch. Naveen-ul-Haq picks up his second wicket. Ireland are falling apart here.
FOUR! Curtis Campher gets his second boundary of the chase here. It is short, on off. Curtis Campher pulls it over mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase but the ball wins the race.
It is full, outside off. Curtis Campher shuffles across and tries to scoop it away but does not connect.
Risky run here! It is full, on off. Tucker pushes it to mid off and scampers across for a quick single. Mohammad Nabi scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Tucker is safely in.
FOUR! EDGY! A good-length ball, outside off. Lorcan Tucker shuffles across and looks to pull it away. It takes the top edge and flies over the keeper for a boundary.
Quicker, outside off. Curtis Campher pushes it out to safety. Just a single off the over. A great start by Rashid Khan.
On off, driven to covers.
Full, on middle and leg. Campher defends it back to the bowler on the front foot.
It is floated, outside off. This one grips and turns in a touch. Curtis Campher stays back and pushes it out.
Outside off, tapped to point.
Tossed up, full and on off. Lorcan Tucker drags his sweep to short fine leg for a single.
Rashid Khan comes into the attack now. He was wicketless in the first two games. Will he be able to get in the wicket's column this time around?
A successful over by Naveen-ul-Haq comes to an end. It is a length ball, on the pads. Curtis Campher looks to tuck it away but it dies in front of him.
Swing and a miss! Good length, outside off. Curtis Campher looks to chase it but misses.
FOUR! Nicely played! Curtis Campher is off the mark with a boundary. Full length, outside off. Curtis Campher leans in and drives it through covers for a boundary.

Just short! Curtis Campher was a goner on his very first delivery. A length ball, around off. Curtis Campher stays back and tries to flick it away. He is a bit early into his shot. It takes the leading edge and lobs towards backward point. Rashid Khan charges towards the ball but it lands safely.
Curtis Campher is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another man bites the dust. It is a short ball, wide outside off. Harry Tector shuffles and tries to cut it away. It takes a thin edge and goes towards the keeper. Rahmanullah Gurbaz makes no mistake behind the sticks. Ireland lose their third wicket inside the Powerplay.
Good running! Naveen-ul-Haq starts with a full-length delivery, on off. Harry Tector drives it to deep point. The batters come back for the second run.
Change. Naveen-ul-Haq comes into the attack now.
On a length, on off. Tector drives it to mid off for an easy single. He gets off the mark.
Play and a miss! A slower full length delivery, outside off. Harry Tector looks to chase it but misses.
On off, defended out.
Harry Tector is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rashid Khan takes a stunning catch at backward point. Andy Balbirnie departs on a low score as well. Both the openers are back in the hut in a jiffy. It is very full, wide outside off. Andy Balbirnie strecthes out and slices it towards backward point. Rashid Khan there keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a brilliant catch to his right. Ireland in a spot of bother.
Commentary.Howout: c Rashid Khan b Fazalhaq Farooqi

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around off. Tucker pushes it to point for one.
SIX! BOOM! Lorcan Tucker continues on his merry way. A length ball, on middle and leg. Lorcan Tucker clears his front leg and tonks it over the mid-wicket fence.
A length ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie works it to mid on off the inner half.
Good length, around off. Andy Balbirnie stays back and punches it to point.
A single now as this is tapped to point.
FOUR! Much better from Tucker this time. He gets the first boundary of the chase. A length ball, outside off. Lorcan Tucker stays back and carves it over point for a boundary.
A loud appeal for caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Good length, outside off. Lorcan Tucker tries to chase it but misses.
On a length, on off. Tucker blocks it back to the bowler.
WIDE! This is a poor start by Azmatullah Omarzai. Three wides on the trot. Once again down leg. Tucker is unable to make the most of it.
WIDE! Full, angled down leg. Tucker misses his flick. Wided.
WIDE! Azmatullah Omarzai spills it down the leg side. Wide called.
Length ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it to backward point. Rashid Khan makes a brilliant stop.
Lorcan Tucker is off the mark. It is full, on off. Tucker drives it to mid off and crossed for a single.
On off, blocked out.
Lorcan Tucker is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A poor delivery from Fazalhaq Farooqi but he gets the better of Paul Stirling. A huge, huge wicket for Fazalhaq Farooqi. It is a full toss, outside off. Paul Stirling reaches out and clubs it towards point. It goes off the bottom half of the blade. Usman Ghani there takes a sharp catch. Paul Stirling has to walk back early on. Pressure on Ireland straightaway.
Commentary.Howout: c Usman Ghani b Fazalhaq Farooqi

Commentary.Commentary: First runs off the bat for Ireland. Fuller in length, just outside off. Andy Balbirnie leans in and drives it towards extra cover. The fielder fumbles and the batters take one.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads, Paul Stirling misses his flick. It goes to fine leg off his pads. They cross for a leg bye.
WIDE! Just like Afghanistan, Ireland's innings also begins with an extra, It is full, lands on leg and drifts down the leg side. Paul Stirling tries to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
